purpose: Check whether an external compatible DeepSeek draft/MTP artifact can unlock verified speculation for the current vendor DeepSeek4 cold-start SOTA path.

current_model.local_metadata_audit: Previous plan records show no mtp, nextn, nextn_predict_layers, draft, or eagle keys/tensors for this accepted model.

observations: The antirez DS4 thread discusses a separate custom CUDA-native DeepSeek4 runtime.
The thread describes MTP as currently broken and CUDA support as not fully ported from MLX.

why_not_immediate_candidate: The current vendor source does not implement a DeepSeek4 MTP target-verification path.
The external MTP GGUF belongs to a different Q2 GGUF/runtime context, not the accepted FP4/FP8 vendor model path.
Tokenizer/vocab compatibility, target verification semantics, RAM/page-cache fit, and VRAM budget are unproven.
Downloading or benchmarking it now would not satisfy the current correctness-first SOTA rules.

future_requirements_before_use: Prove tokenizer/vocab compatibility with the accepted target model.
Implement or port DeepSeek4 MTP runtime in vendor source.
Account for 16GB host RAM including page cache and current VRAM cache pressure.
Pass correctness before any token-rate benchmark.
